intake_turns.user: Hi. Before I tell you anything, who sees my data? And is what you give me advice or just general info?
intake_turns.reply: Your answers live in this browser tab. The server uses them only to read your messages and build your plan. It saves no copy. Its log holds only counts and costs. An outside company does read your messages: each one goes to an AI model, Claude, from Anthropic. Leave out names and account numbers. Rough figures are enough.

intake_turns.user: I'm 49. Thanks for explaining the data part. Is the plan you build general info or actual advice? I want to know before I share my numbers.
intake_turns.reply: Got it: you are 49. No. This is an education tool, not financial advice. It shows what your own numbers suggest. For big decisions, talk to a fee-only adviser who must act in your interest. I filled in 6 more with typical figures. Each is marked in the panel, so you can change it.
